title: Nine Ounces of Cream
subtitle: 黄油与乳制品 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 黄油与乳制品（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：黄油与乳制品（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：butter　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 butter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to churn ① butter she could not weigh, and she said the weighing was the whole of the lesson. The ② butter, meaning the fat and not the cream, was nine ounces and was cut by whoever came last; butter, she said, is the only thing in a dairy that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ butter on that shelf had the same salt, and the ④ butter at the front, meaning the one the dairymaid kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly. Butter, my grandmother said, is nine parts cream and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the cream is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ butter was the whole of the winter, meaning the store it stood for and not the fat. The ⑥ butter, meaning the store and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody spreads and nobody questions; butter, he said, is either something you churn or the only word that means both a fat and a store. She said the store is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ butter had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the cream. The ⑧ butter of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine ounces and eleven years of churning; butter, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ butter I remember is the one at the front, which was shared in 1969 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ pound of butter, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every butter, she said, is a store that has agreed to look like a fat. She said the store was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 黄油（指油脂本身，与奶油相对）
C. 固定搭配：churn butter 搅制黄油
D. n. 黄油（指架子上每一块）
E. n. 黄油（指前面那一块）
F. n. 黄油（抽象：它所代表的储备）
G. n. 那份储备（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The butter, meaning the fat and not the cream
butter was the whole of the winter
the butter had become a number in a report
The butter of the whole thing
A pound of butter, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: churn butter 意为“搅制黄油”，1947 年母亲被派去搅制她称不出重量的黄油。
butter 意为“黄油”，指油脂本身而不是奶油，共九盎司，由最后走的人切下。
butter 指架子上每一块黄油，每一块都是同样的盐分。
butter 指前面那一块（挤奶女工留的那一块），是唯一有人认真称过的。
butter 意为“黄油”，抽象指它所代表的储备，父亲说 butter 就是那个冬天的全部。
butter 为抽象用法，指那份储备本身，是屋子里人人都抹、却没人质疑的东西。
butter 意为“黄油”，到 1964 年这块 butter 成了报告里的一个数字。
butter 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九盎司和十一年的搅制。
butter 意为“黄油”，我记得的是前面那一块，1969 年被分着吃，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
butter 为抽象总称，祖母说一磅黄油是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。
